{{Quote|Master [Yalta Val], we didn't realize...aaaaaarrrrgghh!|The final words of a Stormtrooper during the ambush|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
This '''Ambush''' in the [[Surd Nebula/Legends|Surd Nebula]] was a short battle between the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] and a pair of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], which took place on the floating world of [[Mala (planet)|Mala]] few months after the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. During this brief skirmish, the [[One Sith]] [[Darth Wredd]] and [[Darth Wredd's master|his master]] shot down an Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] carrying the Triumvirate's emissary, the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Yalta Val]] to the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]]. Val had been sent by the Galactic Triumvirate to supervise the final stages of the construction of the [[Carreras G51 communications array]], which was part of a galactic-wide [[G51 communications array]] network. Wredd's master killed Yalta Val's crew and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] escorts and destroyed the shuttle. However, the Sith master was then slain by his apprentice Darth Wredd, who took Val prisoner and impersonate him, stealing his [[Imperial Knight armor|armor]]. This set the stage for the [[Carreras Incident]] and [[Darth Wredd's insurgency]] against the One Sith.

==History==
[[File:Missile_hits_Yalta_Val_shuttle.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Wredd and his master fire on Yalta Val's shuttle]]

===Background===
{{Quote|What hit us?''"<br />"''Unknown. But we're venting atmosphere. We'll never make it ou of the nebula to the nearest known planet! I...I can't believe it! I have something! It's not on the charts, but...|Yalta Val and an unidentified Imperial pilot, after their shuttle comes under attack|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
Following the defeat of [[Darth Krayt]] and the end of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], a new [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] consisting of the [[Fel Empire]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] became the new galactic government. The new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]] embarked on an ambitious project to create a [[G51 communications array|network of communication arrays]] to improve communications between the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]] was designated as the last chain in this galactic-wide communications network. In [[138 ABY]], the Imperial Knight [[Yalta Val]] was assigned to supervise the finishing stages of the [[Carreras G51 communications array]]. His shuttle traveled through the [[Surd Nebula/Legends|Surd Nebula]], a dense region of space where communications was difficult. Yalta Val was accompanied by a small force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and a [[Unidentified Imperial communications droid|communications droid]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />

Shortly after launching their comm droid, Yalta Val's shuttle was hit by a missile, causing them to crash-land on an uncharted planet: the enigmatic floating world of [[Mala (planet)|Mala]]. Unknown to Yalta Val and his crew, they had come under attack by two members of the underground [[One Sith]] order.<ref name="Legacy 1" /> At the urging of [[Darth Wredd]], [[Darth Wredd's master|his master]] had opened fired on Yalta Val's shuttle. Darth Wredd had been forced to join the One Sith, who had destroyed his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] Mala and killed his family with a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. The Sith bioweapon had also loosened Mala from its orbiting, turning it into a rogue planet which wandered through the galaxy. Seeking vengeance against the One Sith, Darth Wredd had tricked his master into attack the Triumvirate starship. During the fighting, Darth Wredd had planned to take the opportunity to kill his master and to break free from the One Sith.<ref name="Legacy 16">[[Legacy (2013) 16|''Legacy'' (2013) 16]]</ref>

===The Ambush===
{{Quote|My apprenticeship is done. And now for you, Knight.|Darth Wredd|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
[[File:Darth_Wredd_revenge.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Wredd killing his Sith master]]
Yalta Val's pilot managed to landed their shuttle on top of a black cliff. Upon landing, the shuttle's stormtrooper escorts disembarked to make a perimeter around their shuttle in order to carry out repairs. Before they could complete their work, they were quickly attacked and killed by Darth Wredd's master, who wielded a [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]]. Yalta Val emerged from the shuttle only to be attacked from behind by the Sith master. During the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], the Sith master used the Force to push the shuttle down the cliff, killing the remaining crew aboard. Yalta Val narrowly survived being crushed by the shuttle and crossed lightsabers with the Sith. Using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], the Sith master gained the upper hand over Val.<ref name="Legacy 1" />

Before he could kill Yalta Val, the Sith master was impaled through the chest by his apprentice Darth Wredd. Putting his plan into action, Darth Wredd disarmed Yalta Val and forced him to strip off his armor and exchange clothes. During his captivity, Val was forced to wear Darth Wredd's Sith helmet, which was designed to drive its wearer to the dark side. Darth Wredd was thus able to impersonate the real Yalta Val and pretend to be an emissary of the Galactic Triumvirate, However, Darth Wredd was unable to find [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|Yalta Val's lightsaber]], which was recovered by Val's comm droid. The comm droid was shortly later hit by debris in the Surd Nebula, knocking it out of action. The droid and its precious cargo, the lightsaber, was later recovered by a pair of junk dealers who sold it to a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] woman named [[Ania Solo]], a distant descendant of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] who owned a [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junk yard]] on the planet [[Carreras Major]], the most populated planet in the Carreras system.<ref name="Legacy 1" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|Madam Governor, There is a Sith presence in this system.|Darth Wredd meeting Governor Biala, while impersonating Master Val|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
[[File:Darth_Wredd_arrives_in_Carreras.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Wredd, impersonating the Imperial Knight Yalta Val]]
A week after the events on Mala, the false Yalta Val's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] was picked up in the [[Surd Nebula/Legends|Surd Nebula]] by the Carreras security forces. He was subsequently brought to the Carreras communications array, which was under the command of the local [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Biala]]. "The Sith impostor claimed that he had been ambushed by the Sith, who had killed his crew and that his lightsaber had been lost during the fighting. Citing the threat of the Sith presence in the Carreras system, the Sith impostor coerced the governor into giving him full control of her security forces to deal with the threat. Meanwhile, the real Yalta Val was imprisoned at Darth Wredd's base on Mala.<ref name="Legacy 1" />

Meanwhile, Ania Solo brought her recently-scavenged comm droid to her [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] friend [[Sauk]], an engineer who worked as a miner on the ice rings orbiting [[Carreras Minor]]. Upon examining the comm droid, they found Yalta Val's lightsaber. Seeing an opportunity to get rich fast, they attempted to sell it to a technology dealer. However, they ended up in a scuffle with several Carreras security personnel, in which Ania killed one of the guards.<ref name="Legacy 1" /> Following a lengthy pursuit, Ania and Sauk managed to escape back to Ania's junkyard. This set the stage for a chain of events which brought Ania and her companions into [[Darth Wredd's insurgency]] against the One Sith and the Galactic Triumvirate.<ref name="Legacy 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The '''Ambush in the Surd Nebula''' served as the main exposition of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Prisoner of the Floating World]]'', the first five-issue story arc in [[Corinna Bechko]] and [[Gabriel Hardman]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 2]]'' comic series. It introduced one of the protagonists, Yalta Val, and the main antagonist Darth Wredd.
